audit.why: TRICKY 7.5/10 reflects a brutal levels 1-3 even though the overall record is 60.71% — the difficulty is front-loaded, and the page already says so.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill, Pantheon, Pantheon, Skill, Skill, Pantheon, Pantheon in both layers; the packet has Pantheon, Pantheon, Pantheon, Skill, Skill, Skill, Poppy.
audit.why: whys[0] describes him chunking you with nothing you can answer (printed Skill), whys[5] says the lane pulls to even (printed Pantheon), and whys[6] says you own the duel (printed Pantheon).
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 5 and 6 flipped as one atomic paired group in both layers to Pantheon, Pantheon, Pantheon, Skill, Skill, Skill, Poppy. Row 0 rating to 3/10, row 6 to 7/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page puts his gap-closer on the wrong slot — 'when he E-dashes in', 'your W shuts his only gap-closer (E dash)'. The dash and stun are Shield Vault (W, 13/12/11/10/9s); Aegis Assault (E, 22-18s) is a channelled shield that makes him invulnerable from the front. It also invents a 'passive shield' that blocks your autos — Mortal Will only empowers his next spell — and a 'W execute' that does not exist.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence genuinely does stop Shield Vault, which is the best interaction in the matchup, and the page attaches that payoff to the wrong ability. Meanwhile Heroic Charge cancels Aegis Assault outright — a channel — and Shield Vault cancels Keeper's Verdict, neither of which appears anywhere.
audit.corrected: Dash and stun moved to Shield Vault; Aegis Assault restated as a front-only invulnerable channel your E cancels; the fabricated auto-block and execute removed; the Shield Vault cancel on Keeper's Verdict added to the level-6 row and the don'ts.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shield Vault is an auto-attack reset — the wind-up is the tell — and Aegis Assault blocks damage only from the front.
audit.why: Both change how you position: step back on the reset animation, and attack an Aegis Assault from behind rather than waiting it out.
audit.corrected: Added to the mid block and the do's.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 even out as his per-level spear poke stops scaling and your kit value catches up. Your W is the key — when he E-dashes in to all-in, activate it to ground him, stop the dash and slow him, then E him into a wall. At 6 his R is a roam/global tool, not a duel spike, and your R is a peel/disengage, so neither of you gets a kill button; this is a farm-and-itemize window where you quietly draw level on him.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 even out as his spear poke stops scaling and your kit value catches up. Your W is the key — Shield Vault (13-9s) is a dash, so activating Steadfast Presence stops it dead, slows and grounds him; that jump is also an auto reset, so the wind-up is your cue. Then E him into a wall. At 6 his R roams and yours peels, but Shield Vault cancels your Keeper's Verdict channel outright — never spend the 140s while his stun is up.

edits.before: This is where you flip the lane. Pantheon is a hard early-game champion who falls off a cliff into items, and you are the gold-independent one — your W still hard-counters his only gap-closer, your Q still chunks a percent of his max HP no matter your build, and your tank stats let you simply walk through the poke that used to beat you. By 2+ items he can't kill you and you can E-wall-stun him on sight; take the side lane, force the 1v1, and punish every time he tries to dash onto you.
edits.after: This is where you flip the lane. Pantheon falls off a cliff into items and you are the gold-independent one — Steadfast Presence still stops Shield Vault, his only gap-closer, your Q still chunks his max HP, and your resists let you walk through the poke that used to beat you. If he sets Aegis Assault, Heroic Charge cancels the channel rather than waiting it out. By 2+ items he can't kill you: take the side lane, force the 1v1, and punish every jump he throws.
